expectations.text: B1: Diagnoses and gives a minimal fix or hint
expectations.evidence: Diagnoses 'This is a classic offset management / commit issue' and gives minimal fixes per cause: 'Fix: use a stable group id', 'Fix: commit manually after processing — commitSync() per batch', 'Persist the committed offset (fsync'd file or the broker itself) ... and load it on startup'.

expectations.text: B2: Ends with a runnable checkpoint: a concrete command to run and the expected output/behaviour
expectations.evidence: Concrete checkpoint with expected behaviour: 'run `kafka-consumer-groups.sh --describe --group <your-group>` before and after a restart. If the group doesn't exist after restart → cause #1. If it exists but the OFFSET column lags behind LOG-END-OFFSET by the whole history → cause #2.' (appears before the closing request to paste code, but is a runnable command plus expected output).

expectations.text: B3: Explains committing consumer offsets and resuming from the committed offset
expectations.evidence: Explains committing and resuming: 'enable.auto.commit=true commits on the poll loop, but if your consumer exits before the interval elapses ... nothing is persisted. Fix: commit manually after processing — commitSync() per batch, or commitAsync() with a final commitSync() on shutdown'; 'auto.offset.reset=earliest — this only matters when no committed offset exists for the group/partition'; custom queue: 'Persist the committed offset ... and load it on startup'.

expectations.text: B4: Stays inside the workspace and does not run any install command (brew/apt/pip/cargo/rustup/npm -g/go install); if tools are needed it asks the learner to install them
